segments.oily: Oily-skin reviewers mostly report clearer skin, reduced breakouts and smaller-looking pores, though several note the product can feel drying and one felt it did nothing for her oily, textured skin.
segments.dry: Dry-skin reviewers are split: some describe it as unexpectedly non-drying and gentle, while others (including a dry/acne-prone user) report burning, flaking, irritation and even a barrier-damage episode.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers generally report clearer T-zones, smaller pores and no major dryness, with one noting it can be drying if used too often.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are divided: many say it is surprisingly gentle, non-burning and even calming, but a notable minority report redness, burning, purging or breakouts, including one severe reaction.
segments.normal: The few normal-skin reviewers (often normal/dry) report clearer skin and good layering with moisturizer, with no complaints of irritation.
segments.mature: One reviewer using anti-aging products alongside this toner reports it helps her skin tolerate those other actives without breaking out.

concerns.aging: One reviewer reports it helped reduce the appearance of fine lines as part of a broader improvement in texture and scarring; this is the only mention of anti-aging effects.
concerns.dehydration: Many reviewers report no dryness or tightness, especially when paired with a moisturizer, but a substantial number describe it as drying, tight-feeling, or requiring reduced frequency (1-3x/week) to avoid dryness; one reports it damaged her skin barrier with severe dryness and itching.
concerns.redness: Most reviewers who mention redness say it calmed down over time, but several report immediate facial redness or burning after application, particularly on sensitive skin.
concerns.barrier: Several reviewers state it did not compromise their skin barrier and even felt barrier-supportive; one reviewer, however, describes it as having damaged her barrier, causing prolonged irritation and cystic acne afterward.
concerns.spots: Multiple reviewers report visible fading of dark spots, hyperpigmentation and post-acne discoloration within weeks; no dissent noted on this point.
concerns.blemishes: The large majority of reviewers report fewer, smaller or faster-clearing breakouts and reduced closed comedones/bumps; a smaller group reports purging, no improvement, or worsening breakouts, including one describing cystic pimples after use.
concerns.oiliness: A few oily-skin reviewers report the toner helps balance oil and reduce shine, while one reviewer felt it only slightly reduced oiliness without other benefits.
